examples.label: Deliverable skeleton
examples.command: # Executive Summary -> Methodology -> Findings (with CVSS + evidence) -> Remediation -> Appendices (raw scan data)

notes:
Sections: Executive Summary, Overview of Assessment, Scope, Vulnerabilities and Recommendations. Graph: vulnerability count by severity.
Severity: Critical/High/Medium/Low.
Per-vulnerability fields: Name, CVE, CVSS, Description, References, Remediation steps, Proof of Concept, Affected systems.
name: Reference - Vulnerability Assessment Report
description: The sections and per-vulnerability fields a VA report should contain.
